scenes.canonical_prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the officer at the head of the column in <Picture 1>: pale skin, dark hair swept back, a black high-collared military coat with silver frogging across the chest, and a long black cape lined in deep red worn from the left shoulder. Retain the face, the high collar, the silver frogging and the red-lined cape; the ranks behind him in the reference are not part of him.
<Setting 1> is the fortress shown in <Picture 2>: a many-towered stone castle on a sheer cliff above cloud, reached by a long arched bridge, under a broken sky with light breaking behind the towers. Retain the silhouette of the towers, the bridge and the cliff.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a night sequence on a castle rampart. <Subject 1> begins an order to the ranks below and the video ends while he is still speaking, so the line is deliberately incomplete at the boundary. Two shots: a close on <Subject 1> turning to the drop, and a wide from behind him over the parapet toward <Setting 1> as the line is cut short by the end of the video.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): partially_preserved - face, coat, collar, frogging and the red-lined cape are held exactly; his pose, the rampart around him and the night light follow the shot description
<Setting 1> (appears in [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - <Picture 2> is the final frame of the target video, so the fortress silhouette, the bridge and the sky at the end of the sequence are exactly the supplied image

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Close single on <Subject 1> from slightly below, night, cold blue key from the left with torchlight flickering warm on his right cheek. <Subject 1> stands at the parapet of a high rampart, the red lining of his cape lifting in the wind, and turns his head sharply toward the drop below. He does not speak in this shot and his lips remain closed as he turns. Torch smoke tears sideways past him and the wind takes the cape out flat.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, cut to a wide from behind his shoulder, over the parapet, <Setting 1> filling the far side of the gorge as the camera settles into the final framing. <Subject 1> raises one gloved hand toward the ranks massed on the bridge far below and begins to give an order. Raising his hand to the ranks below, <Subject 1> begins to call out hard and carrying over the wind, <d>[English] Hold the bridge until the second bell, and do not let them</d><|cutoff|> his mouth still open and mid-word as the video ends. The video ends on this framing with the order unfinished, on the last frame supplied as <Picture 2>.

overall_soundscape:
High exposed wind across stone dominates, with torch flame snapping close on the left and the distant shift of massed armour far below. One hard called English line begins late in the sequence and is still in progress when the audio ends; it is not resolved, faded or completed.

non_diegetic_music:
A low brass swell rising under the second shot, still rising when the sequence ends.

scenes.canonical_prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman defined jointly by the four views in <Picture 1>: silver-blonde hair worn in damp-looking braided strands past the shoulder, pale grey-blue eyes, and a floor-length ivory gown of layered translucent panels with a beaded bodice. Retain the hair colour, the braid structure and the layered ivory gown; the background of the reference sheet is not part of her.
<Subject 2> is the young man defined jointly by the four views in <Picture 2>: tousled black hair to the jaw, dark brows, an off-white loose linen shirt with sleeves pushed to the elbow, and a long dark grey work apron tied at the waist over wide dark trousers. Retain the hair, the linen shirt and the dark apron; the plain backdrop of the reference sheet is not part of him.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a handheld documentary sequence in a glassblowing atelier at dusk. <Subject 1> speaks one line in French to <Subject 2> across a cooling bench while the furnace glow moves across both faces; an English subtitle carries the translation. Three shots: a two-shot establishing the bench, a close single on <Subject 1> as she speaks, and a reverse on <Subject 2> listening in silence.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): partially_preserved - hair colour, braid structure, eye colour and the layered ivory gown are held exactly; her pose, framing and the light falling on her follow the shot description rather than the reference sheet
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3]): partially_preserved - hair, facial structure, the linen shirt and the dark apron are held exactly; his pose, framing and the light falling on him follow the shot description

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Handheld medium two-shot, slight breathing motion, the camera settling as it finds the bench. <Subject 1> stands at the left of a long steel cooling bench in a dim workshop, <Subject 2> opposite her at the right, a row of cooling glass vessels between them catching orange light from an open furnace mouth in the deep background. Neither figure speaks in this shot and both keep their lips closed; the only sound is the room. Heat shimmer rises off the bench between them and warm light crawls across the vessels.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.750, cut to a handheld close single on <Subject 1>, shallow focus, the furnace glow warm on the left side of her face. <Subject 1> lifts her eyes from the glass and looks directly across the bench. Facing <Subject 2> across the bench, <Subject 1> speaks quietly and evenly, <d>[French] Il faut le laisser refroidir jusqu'a demain.</d> her lips moving clearly with the words. A single-line English subtitle is burned into the lower third of the frame, centred, in a plain white sans-serif with a soft dark drop shadow, appearing as she begins to speak and clearing as she finishes. The line reads <|caption_start|>We have to let it cool until tomorrow.<|caption_end|>. She lowers her eyes back to the glass as the line ends.
[Shot 3] At 00:03.500, cut to a handheld reverse close single on <Subject 2>, the furnace behind him thrown far out of focus. <Subject 2> listens without answering, then gives a single slow nod and reaches to draw a cloth over the nearest vessel. <Subject 2> does not speak and his lips remain completely closed throughout the shot. The cloth settles and the orange light on his face dims as the furnace mouth swings shut.

overall_soundscape:
A low continuous furnace roar sits under the whole sequence, close and slightly muffled, with the fine tick of cooling glass in the near foreground. One line of quiet French speech sits clearly above the room tone in the middle of the sequence. A soft cloth drag and the heavy swing of an iron door close the sequence.

non_diegetic_music:
None. The sequence carries room sound only.
